artifact_type: report design specification, not a native Power BI report
source: PostgreSQL payroll_analytics star schema, latest snapshot only

pages.name: Executive Overview
visuals: Clustered bar: department by annual salary, legend country
Matrix: country > department with headcount, median and P90

pages.name: Compensation Analysis
visuals: Bar: job title by average salary
Matrix: department and job title with average, median, P90
Scatter: city headcount against average salary, size annual salary
Detail table: employee ID, salary, currency; no names or email

pages.name: Workforce Profile
visuals: Stacked bar: department by headcount, legend work arrangement
Matrix: country > city with headcount and average tenure

limitations: One synthetic snapshot; no actual payroll payments or trend measures
IQR flags are review candidates, not evidence of unfair pay
INR conversion is fixed and illustrative
Do not sum local salary across currencies
